records.name: Teofilė
records.facts_used: The Senn–Salys dictionary pairs Lithuanian Teofilė with Theophile. This belongs to the feminine Theophila family of Theophilus, from Greek theos, “god”, and philos, “friend”. The link is an explicit dictionary correspondence, not a substitution based only on a similar ending. Exact Teofilė is recorded as a personal name in the dictionary’s 1968 fifth volume, reprinted in 1983. The entry places the Lithuanian spelling within an older Greek-derived family. It dates this dictionary record, without identifying the first Lithuanian bearer or changing the project calendar.
records.reason: Exact-form evidence supports a two-paragraph history in all five languages.
